changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla users: usuarios de la plataforma. Sin contraseña: la identidad se delega a un proveedor externo (Keycloak, pendiente D-03). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría users_audit y el trigger users_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Platform users. No password is stored: authentication is delegated to an external identity provider

column.name: identity_provider
column.remarks: Identity provider that authenticates the user (for example keycloak)

column.name: identity_subject
column.remarks: Subject (sub claim) of the user in the identity provider

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_uq ON users (lower(email))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_identity_uq ON users (identity_provider, identity_subject) WHERE identity_subject IS NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT users_identity_ck CHECK ((identity_provider IS NULL) = (identity_subject IS NULL))

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in users

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users_audit ADD CONSTRAINT users_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER users_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS users_audit_trg ON users
